full_judgment:
Sheikh Abdul Awal J: By this Rule the Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur was called upon to show cause as to why the proceeding of GR Case No. 197 of 2004 arising out of Tongi Police Station Case No. 14 dated 12-9-2004 under sections 143/341/302/379/34 of the Penal Code so far it relates to the present accused petitioner No. 11 Md Solaiman alias Shawpan should not be quashed and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that one Subed Ali Sarker as informant on 12-9-2004 at about 23.55 hours lodged an Ejahar with Tongi Police Station, District Gazipur to the effect that his younger brother Ayub Khan has been running brokery business regarding transfer of land and earth filling work of different Real Estates. On that, out of business enmity accused Zafar Laskar has been hatching cons-piracy to kill the informant's brother Ayub Khan. At which accused Zafar Laskar along with accused named Quamrul Mia, Anwar Hossain, Zakir Hossain, Gazi Miah alias Shwapan, Md Hanifa, Md Zia, Md Abu Hanifa, Md Eunus Mia, A Aziz, Md Bachhu Mia and unknown 7/8 others in a preplanned way armed with Ballam, Ram dao, Chhora, etc attacked the informant's brother Ayub Khan in front of the house of accused Hanifa and then on getting order passed by accused Zafar Laskar the accused persons started beating indiscriminately on the head, chest and back side of the victim Ayub Khan and finally cut his throat for ensuring his death. It has been further alleged that the accused persons also snatched away the victim's mobile phone, cash Taka 50,000 and a gold chain. Upon the aforesaid allegation Tongi Police Station Case No. 14 dated 12-9-2004 under sections 143/ 341/302/379/34 of the Penal Code was started against 1) Zafar Laskar, 2) Quamrul Mia, 3) Anwar Hossain, 4) Zakir Hossain, 5) Gazi Miah alias Shwapan, 6) Md Hanifa, 7) Md Zia, 8) Md Abu Hanifa, 9) Md Eunus Mia, 10) A Aziz, 11) Md Bachhu Mia and unknown 7/8 others. 

 3. Police after completion of usual investigation submitted charge sheet on 12-9-2005 against 12(twelve) accused persons including this petitioner under sections 143/341/302/379 /34 of the Penal Code, vide Charge Sheet No. 146 dated 12-9-2005. 

 8. Mr Sajwar Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the informant opposite party, on the other hand, by filing a counter-affidavit opposes the Rule. He submits that during investigation police found sufficient materials to connect the present accused petitioner with the crime and thereupon submitted charge sheet against the accused petitioner and others under sections 143/341/302/379/34 of the Penal Code. The learned Advocate further on referring the statements of the witnesses recorded under section 161, CrPC submits that witness Nos. 5-10, 15, 17 and 19 disclosed the name of the present accused petitioner that he cut the throat of deceased Ayub Khan with the active help of other accused persons and therefore, the question of quashing of the proceeding does not arise at all.
